what: In a pinned section, between 35% and 65% of scroll the view on one screen switches. The lines of the previous view move out by −10px at .08 intervals, and past the midpoint the head line of the next view rises in from 6px below while the bars grow up from .1× scale. Once a view is picked with the view buttons, scroll no longer switches views and the change plays over 1.5 beats

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
